app.title: CamLooper - Stay Present, Keep Your Privacy

topbar.tagline: Stay present in class while keeping your privacy — record a short clip, then loop it as your camera.

stage.previewPlaceholder: Your camera preview will appear here

step1.title: Step 1 · Go live
step1.desc: This is exactly what your class will see. Pick your camera and sit how you want to appear.
step1.noCamera: No camera found. Plug in a webcam and reopen CamLooper.
step1.loopExisting: Already have a clip? Loop an existing video instead

step2.title: Step 2 · Record your loop
step2.desc: Record 10–30 seconds of yourself looking natural. A few small movements — a nod, a glance — make the loop believable.

review.title: Looks good?
review.desc: Here's your clip. Loop it as your webcam, or record again.

loop.title: You're covered
loop.covered: Your clip is now looping as your webcam. In <apps>Zoom, Teams or Meet</apps>, choose <device>“CamLooper Virtual Camera”</device> as your camera — then you can step away.
loop.liveOnDesc: Your real camera is on. Turn off to go back to the loop.
loop.liveOffDesc: Pause the loop and show your real camera for a moment.

errors.unsupportedFormat: Unsupported video format. Please choose an MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV or AVI file.
errors.uploadFailed: Failed to upload video. Please try again.
